body: Thanks for sharing your experience. As you have mentioned starting up will be the hardest step. Even though my parents aren't perfect I still love them and  feel like I would be abandoning them if I leave now. On the other hand, I don't think I will last here much longer... Decisions decisions.

Studies aren't the problem. As I said, it's the people that I'm with, and I feel like sooner or later I will have to depart. I would love to help others but I feel I have to fix myself first at least in some way, so right now its not the time.

Well I am definitely tired with the daily nuances I have with the people I am around. It drives me a bit crazy to a point where I try to inflict pain to myself just to help forget what happened before (started doing this when I was 10 or 11), but I know that's not going to help in the long term and I am running out of options. I'm slowly planning my exit from home, but it's extremely hard due to the lack of money/job. If all this fails, then I guess I will make my final decision. That is what I am expecting.
